page.intro: The option groups a style offers in the configurator: what a customer may choose, the rules between choices, and what each choice does to the BOM, the routing, the price and the certificate.

keys.add: Add to this tab (option, effect, styles)

kindHint.SINGLE: The customer picks at most one option of the group (a perforation, a protector level).
kindHint.MULTI: The customer may pick several options (logos, patches).
kindHint.FREE_TEXT: Every option takes a text the customer types (a name to embroider).

list.title: Option groups
list.search: Search code, name or an option

filter.styleUnread: A style that could not be read

tile.outside: Options that take a garment outside its certificate
tile.outsideHint: Groups with such an option: the quote warns before it is sold.

notice.label: Notices

ignored.title: Filter not applied: {value}
ignored.body: This kind does not exist, so the list shows every kind.

style.title: The style of the link could not be read
style.body: It may be in a company you do not work in, or your role does not read it. The list shows every group.

empty.title_one: {count} active group has no options yet
empty.title_other: {count} active groups have no options yet
empty.body: A style that offers it asks nothing of it: {codes}.

unoffered.title_one: {count} group is offered on no style
unoffered.title_other: {count} groups are offered on no style
unoffered.body: Offer them on their styles (Styles tab), or archive them: {codes}.

notice.groupArchived: Group archived: no style may offer it anew.

held.noManage: Your role does not keep the option library (the production manager's does).
held.noneActive: None of the selected is active.
held.noneArchived: None of the selected is archived.
held.archived: The group is archived: restore it to change it.
held.valueArchived: This option is archived: restore it to change it.
held.noPrice: Setting a surcharge needs the pricing right and the price grain (sales has them).
held.noOffer: Offering a group on a style needs the right to change styles.
held.offline: Offline — changes wait until the connection is back.

archive.reach: No style can offer it anew; quotes and orders keep the options they name.
archive.offered_one: {count} of them is offered on styles: those offers stay until each style withdraws it.
archive.offered_other: {count} of them are offered on styles: those offers stay until each style withdraws them.
archive.back: Restore brings it back as it was.

empty.title: No option groups yet
empty.body: Start one: a perforation, a protector level, logos or a name to embroider.
empty.bodyView: The production manager starts them; they show here.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to option groups
forbidden.body: Reading them needs the right to read styles (product developers, sales and quality have it).

offline.title: Offline — changes wait to be sent
offline.body: The rows stay as they were read; nothing can be changed until the connection is back.
offline.record: The group stays as it was read; cells, rules and dialogs are held until the connection is back.

style.label: The style's options
style.title: Options of {code} · {name}
style.intro: The groups this style offers, and its BOM lines and routing steps that are only for an option.
style.noOffers: This style offers no option group yet.
style.lines: BOM lines only for an option
style.noLines: No BOM line of this style is only for an option.
style.steps: Routing steps only for some options
style.noSteps: No routing step of this style is only for an option.

group.companyHint: Only this company's styles may offer it.
group.everyCompanyHint: Every company's styles may offer it (it needs a role over every company).
group.name: Name
group.minHint: How many options a style asks at least (0: none is needed).

problem.codeForm: A code has no spaces and at most {max} characters.
problem.name: Give the group a name.
problem.min: At least is a whole number from 0 to {max}.
problem.max: At most is a whole number from 1 to {max}, or empty.
problem.maxBelow: At most ({max}) is not below at least ({min}).
problem.singleMax: One choice takes 1 option at most: at most is 1.
problem.singleMin: One choice takes 0 or 1 option at least.

form.refused: The server refused it: see above.

record.archivedBanner: Read-only: the group is archived. Restore it (⋯) to change it.

options.title: Options
options.intro: Each cell saves on its own.
options.hint: Type in a cell and press Enter to save it. A surcharge is an amount (35 or 35 EUR) or a percent of the price (10 %); empty: none.
options.noPriceGrain: The price surcharge needs the price grain: it is not shown in your role.
options.priceHint: An amount (35, -25 EUR) or a percent of the price (10 %); percents add up and never compound.
options.patternHint: A regular expression the text must match, found anywhere in it: anchor it with ^ and $ (^[A-Za-z ]+$).
options.outsideOf: {code} takes the garment outside its certificate

held.freeTextGroup: Every option of a typed-text group takes a text.
held.noText: Only for an option that takes a typed text.

options.atEnd: It is already at that end.

empty.title: Add options
empty.body: The choices of this group: each option a code and a name.

value.title: Add an option to {code}
value.name: Name
value.freeTextHint: A name to embroider, a number on the sleeve.
value.freeTextGroup: Every option of a typed-text group takes a text.
value.archiveReach: No new configuration may choose it; quotes and orders keep it.
value.archiveUsed: Styles keep their {lines} BOM line(s) and {steps} routing step(s) only for it.
value.archiveBack: Restore brings it back as it was.

held.required_one: {count} active rule requires this option: change that rule first.
held.required_other: {count} active rules require this option: change those rules first.

problem.codeTaken: {code} is already an option of this group.
problem.name: Give the option a name.
problem.freeTextGroup: Every option of a typed-text group takes a text.
problem.maxLength: A typed text is 1 to {max} characters at most: say how many.
problem.pattern: This is not a regular expression: check the brackets and the backslashes.
problem.patternClass: Write the characters themselves ([A-Za-z]), not a class like [[:alpha:]]: the pattern must mean the same in every check.
problem.patternUnicode: A pattern takes no \p{…} class: write the characters themselves.

problem.form: Type an amount (35 or 35 EUR) or a percent (10 %); empty for none.
problem.zero: A surcharge is never 0: leave it empty for none.
problem.percent: A percent from −100 to 1000, with at most 4 decimals.
problem.amount: An amount with at most 6 decimals.

certificate.title: {code} takes the garment outside its certificate
certificate.body: Say what the certificate no longer covers when this option is chosen. A quote warns before such a garment is sold.
certificate.note: What the certificate no longer covers
certificate.noteHint: The customer's and the compliance team's words (at most 1000 characters).

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Requires and excludes, as a block or a warning with a message. Save the set with the bar below.
rules.savedGroup: The group of the saved rule
rules.messageHint: What the person reads when the rule is broken; empty: our own words.
rules.readFailed: Its options could not be read: pick the group again.
rules.later: Allowed-combination tables, rules that hide or lock an option, and a test bench come later.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.body: Add a rule: an option that requires or excludes another one.

problem.subject: Pick the option the rule is about, or any option of the group.
problem.same: A rule is about one option and another, not the same.
problem.anyOwn: A rule about any option of the group names an option of another group.
problem.message: A message is at most {max} characters.
problem.opposite: Rule {other} says the opposite about the same options.

rules.subject: What it is about

effectHint.BOM_ADD: A BOM line the option adds: material, quantity per garment or per size, unit.
effectHint.BOM_REPLACE: Puts another material in place of one of the style's (its quantity, or a new one).
effectHint.BOM_REMOVE: Leaves one of the style's materials out.
effectHint.OPERATION_ADD: An operation the garment needs too (its standard minutes, or yours).
effectHint.MINUTES: Minutes added or taken away, at an operation or on the garment.
effectHint.CERTIFICATE: The garment is no longer the one its certificate covers.

effects.title: Price & BOM effects
effects.hint: Quantities and minutes save per cell (a comma or a point). Material, operation and section change with Edit…; the kind never changes.
effects.noPriceGrain: Price surcharges need the price grain: their rows say the price moves, not by how much.
effects.costLater: An option's cost comes with costing (FIN-018): not counted yet.
effects.scaleHint: Pick a size scale to type quantities per size.
effects.notNumber: Size {size}: «{text}» is not a number — the value stays.

empty.title: No effects yet
empty.body: What an option does to the garment: a material added, replaced or left out, an operation, minutes, the certificate.

effects.amountHint: A BOM line's quantity per garment, or an operation's minutes.
effects.priceHint: The surcharge of the option: an amount (35 or 35 EUR) or a percent of the price (10 %).

effect.fixed: It stays (another one is another effect).
effect.noMaterials: Your role does not read materials.
effect.noOperations: Your role does not read operations.
effect.qtyHint: Per garment; per size in the grid.
effect.qtyReplaceHint: Empty with no unit: the replaced line's.
effect.sectionHint: Where it goes in the BOM (optional).
effect.minutesSignedHint: Above 0 adds, below 0 takes away; not 0.
effect.sizesKept_one: Its quantity for {count} size stays: change it in the grid.
effect.sizesKept_other: Its quantities for {count} sizes stay: change them in the grid.
effect.removeBody: The option no longer does this. Nothing else changes.

problem.item: Pick the material the option adds.
problem.itemIn: Pick the material the option puts in.
problem.targetOut: Pick the material it leaves out.
problem.sameItem: It puts in another material than the one it replaces.
problem.uom: Pick the unit of the quantity.
problem.qtyNeeded: Give the quantity per garment, or per size.
problem.qty: A quantity above 0, with at most 4 decimals.
problem.qtyWithUom: A new quantity with its unit, or neither.
problem.operation: Pick the operation the option adds.
problem.minutes: Minutes above 0, with at most 3 decimals (or empty: the standard minutes).
problem.minutesNotZero: Minutes added (above 0) or taken away (below 0), not 0, with at most 3 decimals.
problem.certificate: Say what the certificate no longer covers.
problem.note: A note is at most {max} characters.

styles.title: Styles
styles.intro: The styles that offer this group, each with its own minimum and maximum.
styles.hint: Type a style's own minimum or maximum; empty: the group's. A released style may need a new revision first.
styles.withdrawReach: The style no longer offers {code} to new configurations.
styles.withdrawKept: When its BOM lines or routing steps name an option of the group, the offer is kept archived so they stay; otherwise it is removed.
styles.withdrawRule: A released style may need a new revision first.
styles.addBody: Pick the styles that offer this group; each takes the group's minimum and maximum until you change them.

held.withdrawn: Withdrawn: offer it again with Add styles.

empty.title: Not offered on any style
empty.body: Add the styles that offer this group.
empty.bodyView: No style offers this group yet.

problem.min: At least is 0 to 100, or empty.
problem.max: At most is 1 to 100, or empty.
problem.single: One choice takes 1 option at most.
problem.contradicts: The style would ask more at least than at most.
problem.whole: A whole number, or empty for the group's.

what.certificate: Outside the certificate — see the note
